requirements.statement: Completed, denied and expired-reserved probe histories beyond a reduced MAX_PROBE_REQUESTS preserve sealed history and replay without exhausting capacity.
A genuinely running probe stays charged while expired reservations release, and fills the reduced cap with one other live request.
Repeated restarted admitted probe lifecycles release exactly once on the accepted 3.3 journal and reaper evidence, preserve replay and keep live executions charged.
After past-cap probe history a normal claim and billing probe succeed through the CLI and product services.
